usedFor: Shopify records the checkout and Whatchimp sends the message, so “Abandoned Checkout” can feed “Send Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Send Message” in Whatchimp
bestTemplate.why: The shopper hears about the cart they left in a message you write, sent through your Whatchimp account.

watchOut: “Send Message” works only within the messaging window, so older checkouts may not get one.
